title: Shrimp Skewers with Croatian Flavor
description: Inspired by the flavors of Croatia, this dish combines succulent shrimp with a tangy and salty marinade. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: zesty
ingredients.notes: marinade made with lemon juice, garlic, and paprika

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together zesty marinade ingredients.
Add shrimp to the marinade and mix to coat.
Thread shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Brush skewers with salty marinade and sprinkle with Croatian seasonings.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Serve hot with a side of your choice.
